subtitle.ko: 피연산자 내림과 올림으로 곱의 범위 만들기
subtitle.en: Bound a product by rounding its operands down and up

rule.ko: 중앙 어림값은 첫 수를 올리고 둘째 수를 내려 곱합니다. 하한은 둘 다 내려 곱하고, 상한은 둘 다 올려 곱해 정확값 없이 범위를 만듭니다.
rule.en: For the central estimate, round the first operand up and the second down. Multiply both lower roundings for the lower bound and both upper roundings for the upper bound, so the range does not depend on the exact product.

outro.en: Find a band around the true answer.

intro.en: Round one up, one down, multiply.
Fill in the last digits yourself.

point.ko: 중앙값은 첫 수를 올리고 둘째 수를 내려요.
point.en: For the central estimate, round the first number up and the second down.

teach.ko: 둘 다 내린 곱은 하한, 둘 다 올린 곱은 상한이에요.
teach.en: The product of both lower roundings is the lower bound; both upper roundings give the upper bound.

bottomOut.en: Here's the estimate and the operand-derived range.
